answer: Require that finality come from strangers. A claim settles only once a quorum of attesters who share no referral edge with its author sign off, bridging the canyon between otherwise separate trust clusters. Sybils spun from a single seed stay one tight violet cluster, unable to self-certify, because their kin edges disqualify one another. Real standing is ferrous: forged slowly from endorsements by unrelated peers, never minted by cloning yourself a hundred times.
